_comment: Pupil centres on the 1280x960 part canvas, for the base face in base/.
Read off a 10x magnification of the pack's own eye tile with a screen
coordinate grid (tools/make_eye_template.py draws the same marks).
Detecting them automatically does not work well enough to trust: the
iris is a gradient, dark at the top and pale blue at the bottom, so a
brightness centroid lands on the lower lid and a colour centroid lands
on the pale half. Both put the eyes about 20 px low. A number that a
person can check against the template picture beats a clever estimator.
